text: Network information and security is an interdisciplinary subject based on computer network technology, with cryptography at its core and offensive and defensive practices as its means. It focuses on protecting network systems, data and user privacy from attacks, leaks or damage. The curriculum system integrates theoretical analysis, technical implementation and security management, covering core areas such as network protocol security, system vulnerability analysis, data encryption, and security attack and defense, and possesses both academic research and engineering practice attributes.
